summary: Dispatches telemetry data to a UI text element based on a mode selector field at this+0xEC. Mode 0x1E0 formats the indexed vehicle list entry, mode 0x1E1 formats the difference between the current delegation value and the vehicle lifetime average, mode 0x1E2 formats the range width, and mode 0x1E3 renders an engine/RPM status string built from a post-process data pointer (falling back to a static string when the pointer is null or the count is non-positive). Every formatted result is handed to UIStringComparison and the function returns 0 on every path.

local_names.this[59]: mode selector (byte offset 0xEC) selecting which telemetry value to display
local_names.v8: current delegation value read via Delegation for mode 0x1E1
local_names.v4: vehicle lifetime average read via VehicleLifetimeAverageAccessor for mode 0x1E1
local_names.v5: range width read via RangeWidthGetter for mode 0x1E2
local_names.v6: count field read from dword_7C54E0 + 16480 for mode 0x1E3
local_names.v7: text pointer at dword_7C54E0 + 17952 (or static asc_5C7370 fallback) for mode 0x1E3
local_names.v9: stack buffer for formatted strings, passed to UIStringComparison

operations.description: Switch dispatch on the mode selector field this[59] (offset 0xEC) via the jump table at jpt_47DBFA: 0x1E0 vehicle list, 0x1E1 delta time, 0x1E2 range width, 0x1E3 engine status; the default case returns 0.

Mode 0x1E0: VehicleDataAccessor(&dword_8AB6EC) reads the vehicle data root, UIListIndexedAccessor selects the indexed list entry, and UIStringComparison(v2) pushes the resulting text to the UI element; then return 0.
Mode 0x1E1: v8 = Delegation(&dword_8AB6EC) gives the current value and v4 = VehicleLifetimeAverageAccessor(&dword_8AB6EC) gives the lifetime average; the displayed delta is v8 - v4.
Mode 0x1E1 and 0x1E2: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck formats the float value with the "%1.3f" format string at a13f, then UIStringComparison pushes the formatted text and the function returns 0.
Mode 0x1E2: v5 = RangeWidthGetter(&dword_8AB6EC) reads the range width, which is then formatted and displayed as in mode 0x1E1.
Mode 0x1E3: when dword_7C54E0 (post-process data pointer) is null, fall back to the static engine-status string asc_5C7370 and display it directly (LABEL_9).
Mode 0x1E3, valid pointer path: v6 = *(dword_7C54E0 + 16480) reads the status count and v7 = (dword_7C54E0 + 17952) is the status text pointer within the engine-status structure.

Mode 0x1E3: when the count v6 is not positive, display the base text pointer v7 directly (LABEL_9); otherwise StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck builds "(%d) %s" from the count and text using the format string at aDS_7, then UIStringComparison displays it.
